description: Test suite for the diff_parser module, including tests for parsing git diffs, extracting language codes from file paths, and generating XML reports for localization changes.

methods.name: parseGitDiff
methods.description: Parses a git diff string and extracts file changes with string modifications.

methods.name: getLanguageFromFilePath
methods.description: Extracts language or locale code from a given file path based on Android resource directory naming conventions.

methods.name: generateXmlReport
methods.description: Generates an XML report summarizing localization string changes, including locale attributes.
